services.title: Tax Preparation
services.text: Amid intricate new tax laws, we commit to diligently scrutinizing and securing every credit and deduction you're entitled to on your corporate, partnership, and individual income tax returns.
services.lead: Navigating your own income tax return can often lead to more questions than answers. Recent data from the US Government's General Accounting Office revealed that the majority of taxpayers (77% out of 71 million) found value in utilizing a professional tax preparer.

covers.title: Complex returns made plain
covers.text: Given the intricate nature of today's tax laws, even a seemingly straightforward return can become perplexing. Unintentionally missing out on entitled deductions and credits is all too common.

covers.title: More than software
covers.text: Even if you rely on software, nothing substitutes the guidance of a seasoned tax expert.

covers.title: How you pay our fee
covers.text: At Garcia's Notary and Income Tax Service, you're in control of how you cover your tax preparation fees as you engage our tax services. Our range of choices caters to all preferences.

covers.title: Electronic filing
covers.text: Opt for electronic filing to expedite your refund beyond traditional paper filing. Choose E-file and ask about our Electronic Refund Check for the quickest possible refund route.

covers.title: IRS Direct Deposit
covers.text: For those seeking a more economical option, and with a bit of patience, consider IRS Direct Deposit, potentially delivering your refund in just 10 to 21 days, right to your bank account.

services.title: Notary Services
services.summary: Notarial acts, available around the clock.
services.text: Embrace the convenience of 24/7 access to our expert notary services, catering to diverse domains including adoption, finance, legal intricacies, real estate transactions, and an array of other specialized areas.
services.lead: When it comes to your document needs, our notaries bring expertise that spans a wide spectrum, covering everything from the intricacies of real estate deeds to the precise language of contracts, and from the criticality of loan documents to the solemnity of affidavits. Regardless of the complexity, our notaries are equipped to handle it all, ensuring the professional finalization of your important paperwork.

covers.title: Available 24/7
covers.text: Our dedication is resolute: to offer you a service that is not only professional and accurate but also characterized by compassion and promptness. We stand by this commitment 24/7, ready to assist whenever you require our expertise.

covers.title: Impartial witnesses
covers.text: Our notaries uphold the legal boundaries set for their role. They serve as impartial witnesses during the signing of documents, refraining from the unauthorized practice of law.

covers.title: Legal and real estate papers
covers.text: Real estate documents, loan documents, title transfers, subpoenas, affidavits, statements, depositions and discovery documents.

covers.title: Medical and family matters
covers.text: Medical affidavits, medical records, wills, codicils, hospital notarizations, adoption documents, parental rights affidavits, guardianships and school documents.

covers.title: Business and insurance
covers.text: Corporate affidavits, insurance documents, claims, releases and billing records.

questions.q: Can your notary give me legal advice about my document?
questions.a: No. Our notaries serve as impartial witnesses during the signing of documents and refrain from the unauthorized practice of law. That keeps their position neutral and protects the legal validity of your documents.

services.title: Refund Options
services.summary: Several ways to receive your refund.
services.text: When it comes to filing your Federal or State taxes, there are diverse options available for receiving your refund. Including the convenience of covering your tax preparation fees directly from your refund.
services.lead: When it comes to filing your Federal or State taxes, there are diverse options available for receiving your refund, including the convenience of covering your tax preparation fees directly from your refund.

covers.title: Refund Transfer
covers.text: A Refund Transfer offers convenience without any upfront fees. You can receive your refund by check, direct deposit or debit card. When the IRS or state disburses your refund, typically within 21 days, your fees can be deducted from the refund proceeds. The balance is then disbursed by a check printed in the tax office, deposited into your bank account, or loaded onto your debit card. Additional fees may apply.

covers.title: IRS Paper Check
covers.text: Once your return is accepted by the IRS or state, the taxing authority will process and mail your refund check. You can expect it to arrive approximately three to four weeks after your return has been accepted.

covers.title: IRS Direct Deposit
covers.text: After the IRS or state accepts your return, your refund will be electronically deposited directly into your bank account. This typically occurs within 21 days of acceptance by the taxing authority.

faqs.a: Monday through Friday, 10 AM to 5 PM, at 2809 Strawberry Road in Pasadena. Notary service is available 24/7.

faqs.q: How do I book a time?
faqs.a: Call 832-328-8799 or use the appointment scheduler on the resources page to pick a slot.

faqs.q: Can I pay my tax preparation fee out of my refund?
faqs.a: Yes. A Refund Transfer lets your fees be deducted from the refund proceeds when the IRS or state disburses it, with no upfront fee. Additional fees may apply.

faqs.q: How fast will my refund come?
faqs.a: IRS Direct Deposit typically arrives within 21 days of the taxing authority accepting your return, and a mailed paper check takes roughly three to four weeks. E-file with an Electronic Refund Check is the quickest route.

faqs.q: Do you handle more than cars for title work?
faqs.a: Yes. Automobiles, motorcycles, trucks, trailers, boats, jet skis and vessels, including salvage and bonded titles.

faqs.q: How do I send you a fax?
Will you text me about my appointment?
faqs.a: Only if you opt in. We use text messages for appointment reminders, service updates, document status notifications, billing notices and customer support. Reply STOP to any message to opt out, or HELP for assistance.
Keiwana McGaw runs the income tax division and is an IRS Certified Licensed Tax Preparer. Cheryl (Cobb) Williams is our business consultant, with over 35 years in the financial industry.
